retrievalProfile.description: A retro-futuristic composition featuring a central rounded-corner illustration of a fantasy landscape with glowing UFOs and a domed palace, topped by glowing neon-tube typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A dark, textured square background containing a vertically oriented rounded-corner window. Inside the window is an airbrushed blue and purple mountain range featuring a domed classical-style palace on a cliff and three glowing, saucer-shaped crafts. Above the window, two tiers of neon-style text glow in pink and green.
coreVisualRelationships: Neon text floating above a framed central illustration
Glowing blue UFOs contrasting against dark purple mountains
Rounded rectangular frame containing the primary narrative scene
Dark textured border framing the central bright elements
coreInvariants: Neon tube glow effect on all typography
Rounded-corner rectangular inset for the main artwork
Monochromatic blue-purple color palette for the landscape

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The landscape illustration is centered and occupies the middle 60% of the vertical space. Neon text is stacked at the top.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The glowing domed palace on the right side of the inner frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the bright pink neon script, move down to the green neon subtitle, and settle into the glowing blue UFOs within the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: A wide, dark, textured border surrounds the central frame and text, providing high contrast for the glowing elements.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep navy and charcoal black background
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Electric blue and violet for the landscape
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Hot pink and lime green for the neon text
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the glowing elements against a low-value, desaturated dark background.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to neon primaries and deep blues

letterConstructionRules: Top line: Continuous cursive script mimicking bent neon glass tubes with visible connectors
Bottom line: Wide, geometric, monolinear sans-serif with open counters
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'y' and 'g' in the script have long, sweeping descenders that connect to adjacent letters
The sans-serif 'A' has a high crossbar
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between fluid, organic script and rigid, geometric sans-serif.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the bent-glass tube look of the primary header
Approximates the wide, geometric feel of the subtitle

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a dark, textured charcoal background. In the center, place a vertical rounded-corner rectangle containing an airbrushed sci-fi landscape with blue mountains, a domed palace on a cliff, and three glowing blue UFOs.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of centered text at the top. The first line should be a pink neon cursive script. The second line should be a wide, green neon geometric sans-serif with high tracking.

verificationChecks: Does the text have a realistic neon glow effect?
Is the central illustration contained within a rounded-corner frame?
Is the color palette dominated by blues, purples, and neon accents?
Are the UFOs depicted as glowing blue discs?

mustRedesign: Exact mountain silhouettes from the original
Specific architectural details of the palace

mustAchieve: Soft airbrushed gradients in the landscape

postGenerationChecks: Check that the neon script looks like continuous tubing.
Ensure the rounded frame has a subtle inner border or glow.
Verify the background texture doesn't distract from the central art.
Confirm the UFOs appear to be emitting light onto the mountains.
recipe.reuseFormula: Dark textured border + Rounded frame illustration (Sci-fi/Fantasy) + Stacked neon typography (Script over Sans-serif).
